title: Canonical affine-line supported fibre and Gysin stalk comparison
statement:
Fix a finite purity setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with coefficient ring $A$, positive level $n$ and $h:e(P)\mid n$. Let $a:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type, and let $s:Y\hookrightarrow\mathbf A^1_Y$ be the zero section. Write $G=Rs^!A_{\mathbf A^1_Y}(1)[2]$ for the actual finite exceptional value of [lem-pur-gysin-structure]. Let $D$ be normalized support data of [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation], so $D.\mathrm{support}:\Gamma(Y,\mathcal H^0G)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^2_{s(Y)}(\mathbf A^1_Y,A(1))$ is its specified chart. Let $H$ be an etale sheaf of $A$-modules and $e:\nu_Y^*H\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal H^0G$. For a map $b:A_{Y,\mathrm{et}}\to H$, let $v_b=\operatorname{ev}_1(\nu_Y^*b\mathbin{\gg}e)$, using the evaluation of [lem-pur-gysin-structure]. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed $k$-field in the scheme universe. The symbol $1_y$ denotes the canonical germ of $1$ in the constant-sheaf stalk, as in [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk]. For every $k$-morphism $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$, there exist a normalized supported-pair transport $p$ for the induced affine-line square, as in [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback], and an $A$-linear isomorphism
$$\gamma:H^2_{s(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)}(\mathbf A^1_\Omega,A(1))\xrightarrow{\sim}H_y$$
such that, for every $b:A_{Y,\mathrm{et}}\to H$,
$$\gamma(r_y^p(D.\mathrm{support}(v_b)))=b_y(1_y).$$
Here $r_y^p$ is the actual kernel-derived supported restriction with the canonical coefficient pullback of [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation]. No finite-type hypothesis is imposed on $\Omega$.

source.place: Step 3: canonical identification of the support object at the geometric point with the stalk; Step 2: the displayed restriction is stalkwise evaluation. Pair functoriality and evaluation use Milne, Lectures on Etale Cohomology, Theorem 9.4 and Example 9.5, pp. 65–67.

proof.text: Apply [thm-pur-affine-line-orientation] to obtain D0, m0 and the normalized transport p and residue rho at the specified point. Apply [lem-pur-affine-line-support-stalk-map] with D, H and e to construct a linear map alpha from H_y to the supported fibre, compatible with all maps from the coefficient unit.

The etale model and etale cover in [lem-pur-gysin-structure] locally identify H0 of the Gysin value with the coefficient unit. Full faithfulness of comparison lifts the comparison between H and that etale model. Choose a cover member above the image of y. Etale inverse image and the geometric-point stalk comparison [lem-weil-pbc-geometric-point-pullback-stalk] identify H_y with A; the proved source-library theorem Etale.nonempty_sheafFiber_iso_of_iso implements this for a chosen point above y.

By surjectivity of gysinHomToSections in [lem-pur-gysin-structure], choose m whose section under D.support is the supported class of m0 under D0.support. Fullness of comparison lifts its degree-zero sheaf map followed by e inverse to b:A_Y -> H. Thus for x=b_y(1), the compatibility equation and the normalization of m0 give rho(alpha(x))=1.

Choose coefficient-line coordinates for source and target. In those coordinates alpha is multiplication by g(1), because g(z)=z*g(1). The equation rho(alpha(x))=1 says that g(1) has an inverse in the commutative ring A. Multiplication by this unit is bijective, so alpha is an isomorphism. Define gamma as its inverse and apply its inverse identity to the compatibility equation for each b. This proves exactly the required formula.

lean.statement:
theorem affineLine_support_stalk (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (h : P.ramificationIndex ∣ P.level) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (a : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated a] [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a]
    (D : OrientationSupportData P h Y)
    (H : ProEtale.RetractedSupport.EtSheaves P Y)
    (e : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).obj H ≅
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ProEtale.RetractedSupport.ProSheaves P Y) 0).obj (P.gysinValue h Y))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra P.field.k Ω]
    (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (hy : y ≫ a = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.field.k Ω))) :
    ∃ p : proEtaleSupportHomTransport P (zeroSection Y)
        (zeroSection (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω))) (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) y),
    ∃ γ : P.gysinSupport h (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)) ≅
        (Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.obj H,
      ∀ b : P.constantEtale Y ⟶ H,
        γ.hom (P.orientationSupportRestriction h y p
          (D.support.hom (P.gysinEvaluate Y
            ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).map b ≫
              e.hom)))) =
          ((Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.map b)
            (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiberConstantSheafIso
              (ModuleCat.of P.Coefficient P.Coefficient)).inv 1)
